{{Top|leg}}
The '''Computer Core''' was located on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], and controlled the [[City/Legends|city's]] life support, machinery, and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] population. It was guarded by seven individual [[security lock]]s. [[X0-X1]] was installed in the Computer Core and attempted to take control of the city, but was foiled by an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] team.
